summary: Add a node of any Godot type to an exact scene, which does not need to be the active editor tab.
Align (min/center/max) or equal-space (centers/gaps) 2-16 ordered 3D subjects along one world axis from their visible AABBs, then save the scene.
Mount a piece on a wall, ceiling or floor — turn its measured back into the surface found by a ray, keep it upright, seat it at a standoff. Saves the scene.
Run engine ops in one call, verbatim; one undo step unless single-only ops split it. ReparentNode keeps and verifies its subtree; raw ConnectSignal is refused.
Save, list, or delete named camera viewpoints stored in the project, so before/after screenshots are taken from exactly the same pose.
Capture real gameplay PNGs (HUD included) offscreen without a running editor; game flags and player steps (press, key, click) get past the title screen.
Check the status of an async generation job by id.
Clear the editor's Output panel for a clean slate before running the game.
Join one piece's port (a Marker3D, or an open pipe end id such as '+Y') to another's, facing it; refuses joins that tilt the piece. Saves the scene.
Connect a signal between two nodes so the saved scene keeps it (CONNECT_PERSIST, verified from the saved .tscn); the receiver should define the target method.
Make a piece of content for a game. Copies a library reference beat for beat with footage on this computer, checks it, saves it to Review.
"Create a support-ready Markdown debug report: doctor checks, engine health, diagnostics, console, and debugger output."
Create a new minimal .tscn on disk with a create-only guard and read-back verification; never touches the open scene.
'One pose as a grid of beauty, lighting-only, unshaded/albedo, world normals, overdraw and wireframe views.'
Enable an editor plugin (res://addons/<name>/) and report the real load result, or that an older engine only queued it.
Export the game in the exact file the Summer Games store takes per platform (iPhone, Android, macOS, Windows bundle; web build; desktop download), headless.
List and install Summer Engine export templates (Summer's WebGPU Forward+ web template, macOS, Windows) from Summer's CDN, sha256-checked.
Fabricate a mesh with a bpy script in the user's own Blender (headless, engine-supervised), import the .glb into res://, optionally instantiate it.
'Frame nodes by their world bounds and render with the scene''s REAL environment and lights (optionally save the pose as a bookmark).'
'Smart framing: find, score and bookmark camera poses for a shot type (establishing, eye level, low-angle, detail, corridor) with in-engine visibility tests.'
Pause the running game, resume it, step exactly N physics or process frames, set the time scale, or list the live game instances.
Drive the running game's input — script timed synthetic events, or record the real inputs and replay them deterministically on a seeded instance.
State AND pixels of one frame of the RUNNING game, atomically — live tree, property reads, and a screenshot stamped with the same frame counters.
Generate a 3D model from text or images via Summer Studio, with optional auto-rig and animation pipeline; returns a job id to poll with nova_check_job.
"Generate audio via Summer Studio: text-to-speech, sound effects, music, or multi-voice dialogue."
Generate or edit an image with allowlisted AI models via Summer Studio; supports text-to-image, image-to-image, and optional background removal.
Generate animation clips for a rigged model — curated humanoid mocap by name, or text-to-motion on any of your own rigs; costs credits, so confirm first.
"Make one sound effect with several models and show the versions in Summer Studio; the person approves one or more and that model becomes their default."
Generate a video from text or an image with allowlisted models via Summer Studio.
"AI-first operating guide for NovaForge Zero-MCP Native Bus: safe workflow, verification ladder, honesty rules, anti-patterns, and recovery steps."
Fetch one asset by exact Summer asset id, including stable file URL, metadata, license, visibility, and provider details.
"Read a sound-effect choice set: whether the person decided, which versions they approved (audioUrl, assetId, note) and their default sound-effect model."
Read recent editor Output panel messages, deduplicated and filterable by level, type, or substring. Editor console only - never the post-play verdict.
Read deduplicated runtime errors from the debugger, distinct from console prints; optional stack traces.
Read runtime warnings from the debugger panel as structured entries with file, line, and callstack.
Prioritized overview of editor console, runtime debugger, and script errors and warnings, with complete counts and a trimmed noise tail.
"Bind to the open project and return a compact context (project, current and main scene, health summary, template pin, memory, warnings); tree on request."
Scene tree of the RUNNING game — spawned enemies, autoloads, pooled nodes — live state the editor reads can never show.
Read a scene's node tree, with explicit depth and limit to avoid the engine's silent default truncation.
Check one GDScript file for parse and compile errors without running the game.
"Discover Summer Studio's guided workflow recipes: starter prompts, ordered steps, required tools, and honest support levels."
Search project files with a regex (ripgrep through the engine) and get file, line and text per match, with optional context lines and a result cap.
Search the asset library and import the best match into the project in one step, optionally adding 3D models to a scene.
Download one file from a URL and run Godot's full import pipeline so the asset is immediately usable.
Download multiple files by URL in one operation with a single filesystem scan afterwards.
Search Poly Haven's CC0 HDRI library and import one into res://sky/ as environment lighting, with the exact run-script snippet that wires the sky.
Create an input action if needed and bind keyboard or mouse events to it.
Measure a 3D asset file without adding it to a scene — AABB, origin, meshes, largest planar faces, open pipe ends, Marker3D anchors, collision shapes.
A node's editable properties with values, Variant types and resources, or only named fields plus derived transform, global_transform, scene_file_path.
Read a resource file (a mesh's AABB, surfaces and materials; a scene's nodes; any resource's non-default properties) or a resource a node holds.
Live properties of one node in the RUNNING game — actual stats, position, flags — without stopping the game and losing the state.
Add an existing scene or 3D model file as a child node, optionally placed in the same call (position, rotation_degrees, scale or transform).
Check whether the game is running; returns the active scene path when it is.
Gap or overlap per axis between two placed nodes, or whether one face of many nodes is coplanar — catches facade gaps and modules standing proud. Read-only.
Read-only reachability between two world points on the scene's Godot navigation map — readiness, snapped endpoints, route length, up to 16 route points.
Open the exact local://novaforge-hub page or editor surface by intent name — billing, my games, an MCP guide, a scene, a node, a dock — or print the URL/op.
Open the project's configured main scene from project settings instead of guessing scene filenames.
Open a scene file in the editor to switch tabs.
Move one node so its bounds face sits against another's along an axis, lining up the other axes — facade modules edge to edge, storeys stacked. Saves the scene.
Start the game quietly (editor keeps tab and focus) — main or a given scene, embedded or offscreen, with pins, or a local multiplayer session (players).
Set one project.godot setting, like main scene, window size, renderer, or gravity.
'Create a project on this computer. Writes a template (3d-basic by default) to a folder, no shell needed. Returns projectPath. Next: projects.open_local.'
'Open a project in Summer Engine. Waits until it connects; installs the engine only with install: true (the person''s yes). Next: engine.get_project_context.'
Cast one ray from any point in an open scene — hit node, point and normal; physics first, visual AABB fallback declared. Read-only.
Read a project text file, a line or byte window of it, or the entries of a .json picked by json_path/keys, with the full-file sha256 receipt.
Load one library entry by id — a skill's body and metadata, a tool's call recipe, a template's pin, a reference's text — ending in the feedback footer.
Read the newest engine events (saves, plays, op receipts, script errors, imports) in one zero-wait poll — and the next_seq cursor to wait from.
Remove a node and all its children from a scene; undoable, but destructive.
Instance copies of one scene along a line in one call — clamps every 0.45 m, braces, fence posts, window rows — and get the created node paths back.
Replace a node with another scene or type, keeping its parent, index, name, transform and children, and verify the saved scene holds it.
"Safely replace text in an existing project file: unique match required by default, then a sha256-guarded write."
Run an EditorScript `func _run():` in a fresh headless child editor against the on-disk project — the cold path for batch and project-wide jobs.
Run a GDScript `func run(ctx):` inside the live editor against scenePath — one script instead of a chain of add-node/set-prop calls.
Drive and read animation in the RUNNING game — AnimationPlayer clips, AnimationTree state machines, and live Skeleton3D bone poses.
Call one method on a node in the RUNNING game and get its return value — trigger gameplay code directly instead of waiting for input or timers.
Set one property on a node in the RUNNING game — the live object, never the scene file — and read back whether it applied.
Spawn a PackedScene into the RUNNING game (action spawn) or free a live node (action free) — stage a test in seconds without touching the scene file.
Save an explicit scene to disk, for standalone saves or save-as.
'Read-only pass over any 3D scene, from geometry and materials: see-through holes, exposed edges, open pipe ends, floor gaps, clipping props.'
Capture a frame from the editor viewport, an offscreen scene render (fixed or bookmarked pose, numbered labels), or the running game, as an actual image.
Search the Summer asset library and your own assets by keyword and meaning; returns names, types, preview and import-ready URLs.
Search the Summer library by describing the task in plain words — ranked entries of every kind, with the id to load next via nova_read_library.
Select a node in the editor scene tree and show it in the inspector.
Set a node property using Godot string syntax for vectors, colors, transforms, and resource class names.
Set a nested property on a resource attached to a node, like a collision shape size or material color.
'Render N bookmarks and/or poses into one labelled grid image with real lighting; compare each bookmark with its previous render (difference map).'
Detect and crop every distinct game asset from a generated sheet image, uploading named slices with bounding boxes.
Move one 3D subject along a world ray until it sits at the requested gap from the first surface (floor, ramp, shelf, table), then save the scene.
Diff two world snapshots into added/removed/changed nodes and count deltas — the structural receipt that a mutation did exactly what was intended.
Read-only 3D placement rundown for one node — 26 directional clearance casts, contact-or-overlap evidence, grounding, nearby geometry. Never moves or saves.
"Plan the right Summer workflow for a game-building task: skill routes, tool groups, confirmation gates, and verification steps."
Stop the running game (or one named offscreen instance). Does not revert scene edits, undo anything, or save — the editor state is left exactly as it is.
Ghost-test one 3D node at a candidate global pose without moving it — overlap evidence, grounded state, signed floor gap. Read-only.
List the editor's named actions or invoke one by name exactly as its menu item / shortcut would — open Project Settings, switch screens, toggle panels.
Activate one editor control by tree path — press, toggle, focus, select a tab, type text, dial a value — or dismiss a blocking dialog; state is read back.
PNG of the editor window or one dock/dialog/control as an image — the pixels-last fallback for looking at the editor UI, never for picking click coordinates.
Structured tree of the live editor UI (controls, paths, text, state) or every visible dialog with its blocking flag — the cheap alternative to a screenshot.
"Show the person what you work on: the editor view (home, chat, 3D, 2D, script, game, Studio), the right rail, the focus and the nodes to frame."
Wait for an engine event — the game starting, an op finishing, a script error, a save — instead of sleeping and re-polling; honest timeout.
Structured scene snapshot (paths, transforms, world AABBs, fingerprints, counts), filterable by subtree, class and field; the read around every mutation.
Create or safely overwrite one complete text file through the identity-bound engine; exactly one guard is required, so writes fail closed.
'High-resolution close-up of exactly a frame region or of mark N, rendered as the exact sub-frustum at full resolution (real detail, not upscaled pixels).'
Compile a visual Blueprint graph into GDScript or C++20 GDExtension code.
Import .blend/.glb/.fbx/.obj/.dae/.usd/.abc/.ply/.stl and auto-bind PBR textures.
Generate a watertight 3D mesh + PBR texture + 3 LODs locally from an image or text prompt.
Fit a 52-bone Humanoid Skeleton3D with geodesic skin weights and retarget animations.
Extract 3D root motion, body/finger/face animation, Foot-Locking IK & hitbox tags from video.
Create a live in-engine cutscene trigger, camera rail, rack-focus DOF & seamless gameplay blend.
Attach interactive door/pickup/weapon/lever or Voronoi 3D destruction behaviors to a 3D prop.
Configure modular NPC senses, combat tactics, free-talk voice & Evolving Life / Nemesis AI.
Switch visual tier between AAA_UNREAL, STANDARD_UNITY, INDIE_CEL_ANIME, INDIE_LOWPOLY_COZY, INDIE_HD2D, INDIE_PSX_RETRO.
Switch camera & movement rig between FPS, TPS_SHOULDER, TPS_SOULS, SIDE_2_5D, HD_2D, ISOMETRIC, PURE_2D, FIXED_CINEMATIC.
Dispatch a prompt across the 5-Brain Local AI Council via Colibrì tiered memory.
Create or restore an instant project snapshot before/after AI edits.
